requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: Level 6J uses the 2018, 2019 and 2020 hire cohorts until the mandatory 1 January 2026 promotion. Pre-2018 hires and apprentices before the cutoff are refused without verified prior classification or apprentice progression. Promotions with matured seniority increments are refused unless the worker states earned increments at their original amounts; that fact preserves the unfinished biennium.
requirements.remediation: Implement the separate 24-month apprentice classification progression for level 6J.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: Art. 56 pays 18% of the global hourly pay on supplementary hours up to 30% of agreed annual hours, and 40% on the excess. The rate past the yearly share is paid when the event states the supplementary hours worked earlier in the year and the agreed annual hours (OvertimeEvent.supplementary_hours_before, agreed_annual_hours); without them the base rate is paid and the run carries this limitation. Saturday work has separate Art. 13 rates.
requirements.remediation: State OvertimeEvent.supplementary_hours_before and agreed_annual_hours on the supplementary hours.
